captions.formal: A small orange kitten emerges from beneath dense shrubbery and walks steadily toward the camera along a sun-dappled dirt path.
captions.sarcastic: Truly, nature's greatest predator: twelve frames of absolute focus to cross approximately six inches of dirt.
captions.humorous_tech: The orange microservice exits its bush container and begins its rollout toward production with zero latency and alarming confidence.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The kitten advances with the single-minded determination of someone who has just spotted the one person at the party who still has snacks.
